facts.fact: Kenya, South Sudan, Uganda and Rwanda, meeting in Nairobi at the Connected Africa Summit 2026, resolved to work towards a jointly owned regional communication and broadcasting satellite, with a feasibility study first, shared-funded by the four states; the meeting date is not given beyond the report's 2026-05-04 publication and 'late last week'.
